He transitions into a brown wig and brown t-shirt, showing a Coca-Cola bottle with 'Jordan' printed on it in red and white. (2) The scene shifts indoors to a living room where the man is reading a purple book. Another version of himself in a green button-down shirt approaches, and a 'Edward' Coca-Cola bottle is held prominently in the foreground. (3) On a rooftop balcony with a wooden deck, the man in a pink shirt interacts with another version of himself who has a towel draped over his shoulders. He presents a bottle labeled 'Will' against a backdrop of a city skyline and green hills. (4) The man appears wearing a long blonde wig and a red hoodie in an outdoor setting, holding a bottle labeled 'Linda' and smiling widely at the camera. (5) In a final indoor setting, the man holds a smartphone while a promotional graphic for a Coca-Cola digital campaign overlays the screen, showing various bottle labels and QR codes.
